text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...
No matter how many times I give warnings, the littering never decreases...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ah!? You do it again right after I told you!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You there, no littering!!
Hold it right theeeere!!" handheld

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dealing with the endlessly persistent littering
left Fenomeno thoroughly exhausted,
both in body and mind.
